author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
It's officially launch day for Grand Theft Auto 6 (if you're in New Zealand) and the game has racked up an impressive near-perfect 99 on Metacritic. The only other game to achieve such a feat is 1998's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the Nintendo 64 (the recent remake scored slightly lower at 95). In related news, if you bought the Ultimate Edition of GTA 6, you might be wondering where all your bonus content is. It's actually spread throughout the game, so you'll need to progress through the story to unlock all of it. And finally, if you haven't updated your PS5's firmware yet, do so now or you won't be able to play GTA 6 when it fully unlocks. The game requires the latest firmware to even run.
title: GTA 6 Joins Zelda As Highest-Rated Game of All Time - IGN Daily Fix

Don't miss the ‘Meeting Carl Weathers’ Clip for I Play Rocky, a dramatic biopic film distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. The legendary Carl Weathers auditions in I Play Rocky, in select theaters now and everywhere on November 20.

Take a look at the Returning to Theaters Trailer for Project Hail Mary, the hit sci-fi drama based on Andy Weir's New York Times best-selling novel. An unlikely duo embarks on a last-chance mission in Project Hail Mary, returning to theaters for award consideration on December 11, including IMAX and 70mm screenings. 

A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

Project Hail Mary stars Ryan Gosling, James Ortiz, Sandra Huller, Lionel Boyce, Milana Vayntrub, and more. The film is written by Drew Goddard and Andy Weir and is directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller.

Project Hail Mary returns to theaters for award consideration on December 11, including IMAX and 70mm screenings.

author: IGN
description:
While this may not be the very first minutes of Rockstar’s latest Grand Theft Auto, it is taken from the first proper mission of the game, which takes place after a short prologue. The reason for this? We think it would be nice for you to experience the start of the story for yourself, and it means we can avoid any potentially cool reveals or spoilers in that story-heavy prologue and focus on the gameplay itself.

In the roughly 15-minute section, you’ll see Jason, alongside his friends Cal and Donnie, complete a little drug-running operation near Key Lento — part of GTA 6’s fictional Florida Keys archipelago. You’ll get to check out just how stupidly gorgeous that water looks, a blend of both stealth takedowns and loud gunplay action, as well as some of that trademark Rockstar humour. Enjoy!
title: 15 Minutes of GTA 6 PS5 Pro Gameplay (First Mission)

author: IGN
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 reviewed by Luke Reilly on PlayStation 5. Also available on Xbox Series X|S.

"As optimistic as I was about a new GTA built in the wake of everything Rockstar learnt from the majestic Red Dead Redemption 2, I was simply not ready for just how much richer, deeper, and more satisfying Grand Theft Auto 6 has proven to be. After three weeks and over 120 hours playing it, I’m still hopelessly hooked, absorbing the world at walking speed like a tourist in a new town. I’m dazed by just how consistently I find myself noticing a new animation, unique pedestrian, or standout vehicle. I am completely enamoured with its series-best car handling and weaving through the realistically dense traffic. I am smitten with its spark-filled shootouts, potent explosions, and the brutal consequences of high-calibre exchanges. I am floored at how outright gorgeous the entire map is from any distance, and I am utterly gobsmacked at how beautifully lit it is at all times – especially dawn, du
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) Review

description:
Check out the trailer for the upcoming anime, Giant Ojosama! The series is coming January 2027 to HIDIVE.
Oriko Fujido, heiress of Fujido Zaibatsu, the world’s largest beverage and vending machine company, was given a town as a present for her 4th birthday. Ever since, Oriko has worked hard to help the town grow with the help of her butler and researcher, Dr. Sebastian. Now, a little over 10 years later, the town is suddenly invaded by an enormous kaiju and the ever boastful Oriko declares she must protect it! To aid her, Dr Sebastian creates an experimental energy drink. Upon drinking it, Oriko grows almost instantly into a skyscraper-sized giant. However, in her zeal to protect the town and battle the kaiju invader, Oriko also unintentionally creates havoc!
title: Giant Ojosama - Official Teaser Trailer (2027)
